annotation.interpretation_a: Clients MUST begin all streams they initiate with an odd number, and continue incrementing odd numbers for subsequent streams.
annotation.interpretation_b: Clients MUST initiate *at least one* stream with an odd number, but may use even numbers for other streams.
annotation.justification: The clause states clients 'MUST initiate streams' with odd numbers. This could mean all streams, or just the first stream. Both interpretations are reasonable and lead to different implementations.
annotation.missing_information: It is unclear whether the requirement applies to all streams initiated by the client, or just the first one. A missing constraint on the sequence of stream IDs would clarify this.
